structured_output.analysis: The best recipe is iso_3.15. It measured KL=0.436 (E514ab09c524e) at 3.14795 average bits. The budget is 403/128 = 3.1484375, so only about 0.0005 bits per weight is free. An int3→int4 or int2→int3 upgrade of one 3.1M-parameter MLP layer costs about 1 bit per weight, so each one would need an equally large downgrade somewhere else. The evidence does not show low-sensitivity layers to downgrade. Swapping methods at the same bit width also gains nothing here: the loss-concentration layers already use their best int3 or int2 variant. Examples are gptq_int3 on 27.up_proj (E04d8aa7bded vs E8972491007e7), rht_gptq_int3 on 3.up_proj (E6f4f7ea296d5 vs Ec98ddfd45576) and rht_gptq_int2 on 14.down_proj (E4c3f9b73e065 vs E811deddc975e). The best lever that costs no bits is the GPTQ options: act_order, damp and block_size do not change the stored bits. The predicted KL of 0.398 is below the measured 0.436, which points to errors adding up across layers. Better per-layer GPTQ error compensation could help with that.

proposals.name: iso_3.15_actorder
proposals.rationale: No cells change, so the bits stay at 3.14795 (E514ab09c524e), under the 3.1484 budget. The change turns on weight_algo.act_order=true for every GPTQ variant. Together these cover 179 of the 196 layers, and they carry the largest losses. Examples: 27.up_proj gptq_int3 measured 0.00572 (Ef04d8aa7bded) and 14.down_proj rht_gptq_int2 measured 0.00633 (E4c3f9b73e065). Ordering columns by activation size should help most where the activations are strongly heavy-tailed, as in 27.up_proj (activation kurtosis 1090, E24beed188b6a).

proposals.name: iso_3.15_actorder_damp05
proposals.rationale: Same bits as iso_3.15 (avg 3.14795, KL=0.436, E514ab09c524e). This adds weight_algo.damp=0.05 to act_order=true. The idea is to regularise the Hessian when calibration covers only 8x512 tokens, which may otherwise overfit. The measured total 0.436 is above the 0.398 single-layer prediction, which suggests the quantized layers do not hold up well together. The rht_gptq_int2 layers lose the most, e.g. 18.gate_proj at 0.00497 (Eb1dd74cd6447) and 11.gate_proj at 0.00443 (E9c454f30c659).

proposals.name: iso_3.15_damp05
proposals.rationale: Control run with the same bits as iso_3.15 (KL=0.436, E514ab09c524e). It changes only weight_algo.damp=0.05, with no act_order, so the effect of damp can be separated from act_order. This targets the losses on the GPTQ-quantized MLP layers, such as 3.up_proj rht_gptq_int3 at 0.00642 (E6f4f7ea296d5) and 1.up_proj rht_gptq_int3 at 0.00611 (E0564bc6ad1eb).
